newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Jan coconut exports $74.969 million.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Jan coconut exports $74.969 million.

text.p: Philippine coconut export revenues in January this year increased to $74.969 million compared to the year-ago $63.041 million, trade group Philippine Coconut Associations of the Philippines Inc (UCAP) said on Tuesday.
The revenues exclude earnings of oleochemicals exports, UCAP said in a statement.
It said volume of coconut exports in January reached 145,567 tonnes in copra terms from the year-ago 130,893 tonnes.
"Bigger volumes traded and better prices during the month pushed revenues higher," UCAP said.
Coconut oil exports accounted for the bulk of the January revenues with $61.949 compared to the year-ago $51.096 million.
Sales of copra meal also increased to $7.627 million from $5.869 million while income from dessicated coconut fell to $5.39 million from $5.41 million.
UCAP said coconut oil exports jumped to 84,928 tonnes from 74,074 tonnes in the same period last year. It said 50,266 tonnes of last January's total went to the United States.

Shipment of copra meal, mostly to Europe, grew at 67,901 tonnes from 52,589 tonnes. Dessicated coconut exports dropped to 4,179 tonnes from 4,829 tonnes while exports of oleochemicals were up slightly at 4,300 tonnes from 4,296 tonnes.

Average export price of coconut oil increased to $729.44 per tonne FOB as against $689.81 per tonne in the same period in 1996. Price of copra meal averaged $112.34 per tonne FOB from $111.61 per tonne while dessicated coconut averaged $1,289.95 per tonne FOB from $1,120.51 per tonne.
